images.alt: Beyond The Vines x Yashica Funtastic Keychain Camera

tabs.panelHtml:
• Product Details
  • Product Measurement

  • The Beyond The Vines x Yashica Funtastic Keychain Camera is a pocket-sized reminder to look a little closer. Small enough to clip onto your bag or keys, it’s made for capturing whatever catches your eye along the way — from the everyday to the slightly unexpected.

    The camera captures both photos and videos, with built-in filters to switch up the mood as you go. And when you feel like turning the camera on yourself, simply flip up the screen for selfies. Whether it’s something worth remembering or an ordinary moment that suddenly feels a little less ordinary, there’s always something to capture.

    Each camera also comes with a sticker pack, so you can make it unmistakably yours. Once you’re done shooting, clip it back onto your bag and keep it close — ready for whatever catches your eye next.

    What’s in the Box:
    - Beyond The Vines x Yashica Funtastic Keychain Camera
    - Detachable keyring
    - Sticker pack
    - USB Type-C charging cable

    Micro SD card required for use, sold separately.

    If you run into any hiccups with your Funtastic KeyChain Camera, pop by the Yashica Page to find steps to help troubleshoot and get back to capturing those fun moments!

    100% ABS

  • L 2 ¼" X H 1" X D ¾"

    Image Sensor: 1/4" CMOS, 1MP
    Lens: F2.8 / f=3.2mm
    Shutter Speed: 1/125s
    Shooting Distance: ~30cm – ∞
    Screen Size: 0.96"
    Image Output: JPG
    Image Format: 1440 × 1080
    Video Format: AVI
    Frame Rate: 30 FPS
    Memory Card Requirement: Micro SD 4GB–64GB, Class 10 UHS-I, U1/V10 or higher (Not included in the camera)
    Data Transfer / Charging Interface: USB Type-C
    Battery: Built-in Li-ion 200mAh
